title: Remove Zero Sum Consecutive Nodes
description:
Given the `head` of a singly linked list of integers, repeatedly delete consecutive sequences of nodes whose values sum to `0` until no non-empty consecutive zero-sum sequence remains.

To guarantee a unique output when multiple zero-sum sequences overlap, process nodes from left to right and always remove the earliest-ending zero-sum sequence first (equivalently, starting from a sentinel node before `head` with prefix sum `0`, link every surviving node directly to the node immediately following the rightmost occurrence of that same prefix sum). Return the head of the resulting linked list.
constraints: The number of nodes in the list is in the range [0, 5000].
hints: Two nodes share the exact same running prefix sum if and only if the contiguous sublist strictly between them sums to 0.

In a first pass from a sentinel dummy node, map each prefix sum to the last node achieving it; in a second pass, set `curr.next = last[prefix].next` to jump past all zero-sum segments in O(n) total time.

examples.explanation: The prefix [1, 2, -3] sums to 0 and is removed, leaving [3, 1].
The subarray [3, -3] sums to 0 and is removed, leaving [1, 2, 4].
The contiguous sequence [2, 3, -3, -2] sums to 0 and is removed, leaving [1].
